lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial slits, arranged in a staggered grid with significantly higher inter-centroid spacing relative to the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with larger lateral blobs, creating visible anchor nodes in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal features visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to low-luminance ventral shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct spatial frequency shift in luminance maxima, transitioning from large, low-density spots on the lateral flank to a high-density micro-spot constellation on the rostrum.
